body: GET /api/tickets/:id/comments returns {items,total,offset,limit}; default is the newest window of 20, ?offset paging, ?around=<commentId> centres the window on a comment (found:false if missing), 404 for unknown tickets. Detail shows 'Comments (total)', 'Show earlier comments (n)' keeps the reading position (anchor shift 0 px), 'Show newer comments' after deep links, focus moves to loaded comments; stale responses ignored. Verified in Chromium with 60 comments.
author: claude
